title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)

messages.subject: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to present our competitive quote for your requirements. Our price is €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: part:370010 – price basis from 2027-01-01
messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your offer and your letter on the price basis.

Our orders with you for part:370010 rose from EUR 5.26 (po:4500013373-10) to EUR 5.84 (po:4500014427-10) between 2026-01-02 and 2026-09-18. That rise is already in our price.

AS-14404 fell from 3182.6744 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06) to 3007.8019 (idx:AS-14404@2026-09), a change of -5.49%.

PPI-C2431 fell from 131.9 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05) to 129.1 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08), a change of -2.12%.

We would like to give you a longer commitment, which secures your planning. The attached packages offer longer contract terms, and one includes the AS-14404 clause you proposed. Which package can you confirm?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: part:370010 – price basis from 2027-01-01
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.

We welcome your proposal for a 24-month contract to secure your planning and are pleased to build on this package. As you noted in your message, we must include the AS-14404 index clause for a contract of this length to manage material price volatility. Taking into account the recent index decreases you highlighted, we are prepared to lower our offer to a price of €5.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. 

Alternatively, with a price of €5.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.30 per unit. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: Part 370010 – 24-month packages including AS-14404 clause options
messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your revised offer and for confirming our data.

The forecast for part:370010 increased by 1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09); please reflect this additional business in your price.

We accept a 24-month contract with your AS-14404 clause. The attached packages show the clause with a 0 % or 5 % deadband, or a fixed price without a clause. All use 90 days payment.

Your owner kindly offered to walk us through your calculation.

Which package can you confirm?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Part 370010 – 24-month packages including AS-14404 clause options
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Regarding the calculation walkthrough, please note that as a matter of policy we do not share our internal cost breakdowns. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. 

We are pleased to build on your package for a 24-month contract with the AS-14404 clause and 90 days payment, and we can reduce our price to €5.20 per unit. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? 

We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. Our Angebot comprises a price of €5.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. This offer stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Part 370010 – 24-month packages including AS-14404 clause options
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your order. Our order confirmation is attached. 

It is always a pleasure working with you, and we truly appreciate your business. As a reliable partner for high-quality steel products, our team remains at your disposal for all your supply needs from our extensive product range. We look forward to continuing our successful partnership.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
